title: SQLite Critical CVEs or LLM Slop? | JFrog
excerpt: The JFrog security research team recently identified a supply chain attack targeting the `xinference` package on PyPI. Versions 2.6.0, 2.6.1, and 2.6.2 were compromised and yanked by maintainers after users reported suspicious behavior. If you installed or imported these versions, you must assume your environment is compromised.
content_html:
Over the past few days, a newly created GitHub repo (programmervuln/cveadvisory-) published a batch of SQLite vulnerability advisories (as part of other 50+ CVEs which we believe are also LLM slop except from one). NVD quickly flagged these as critical, and CISA's ADP agreed. But when JFrog security researchers dug in to verify, the claims fell apart:

  1. The cited code didn't even exist in those versions or referenced unrelated logic.
  2. When testing the PoC payloads they didn’t work (not triggering any crash).
  3. None of these CVEs are listed on SQLite’s official advisory page (which is a gold standard for tracking actual vulnerabilities).
  4. All advisories in this repo seem AI generated when testing them with Gptzero

Combining all advisories into one file triggers AI-generated content warnings

This made us question the reliability of these CVEs as well as understanding that these CVEs may be LLM slop.

While investigating one of the CVEs yesterday, CVE-2026-51302, we saw that Red Hat initially assigned it a 10.0 Critical severity score:

Looking at the CVE again today, we noticed that the score has since been downgraded to 7.6 High.

CVE Reported Flaw CVSS NVD Metadata Audit Finding
CVE-2026-51302 UAF in exprComputeOperands() 9.8 CRITICAL Pinned CPE: 3.41.0 The advisory mentions non-existing functions.
CVE-2026-51303 UAF in ExprListDelete() back-refs 9.8 CRITICAL Contradictory metadata The advisory said there are non-existent fixes.
CVE-2026-51300 UAF in sqlite3ExprDelete() 9.1 CRITICAL n/a placeholders Advisory cited lines that are unrelated to the vulnerability.
CVE-2026-51297 UAF via jsonBlobEdit() 8.8 HIGH Pinned CPE: 3.41.0 The advisory mentions non-existing functions.
CVE-2026-51296 UAF in jsonRemoveFunc 7.5 HIGH Populated CPE: 3.41.0 Advisory cited lines that do not exist.
CVE-2026-51304 UAF via pOrderBy->nExpr post-free 7.5 HIGH Vendor/Product: n/a Advisory showed a real function with a wrong argument number.

To verify these reports thoroughly, we established an isolated testing workflow:

  • Source Inspection: We cloned the official sqlite/sqlite repository and checked out the target tags (version-3.41.0, version-3.51.2, and version-3.51.3). We compared the reported vulnerability mechanics against the actual source code.
  • Clean Environment Build: Compiled the official SQLite releases directly inside isolated Docker containers to prevent environmental contamination.
  • PoC Execution: Feed each advisory's PoC SQL statements verbatim into the compiled SQLite binaries under AddressSanitizer (ASan) instrumentation to detect memory bugs.
  • NVD & Metadata Audit: Evaluated the CPE patterns and advisory metadata across NVD and GHSA feeds to cross-check tracking accuracy.

Reported Vulnerability: The advisory claims a heap use-after-free occurs when sqlite3ReleaseTempReg() leaves a dangling pointer in regFree1, which is later dereferenced by exprComputeOperands().

Finding: The primary issue here is that exprComputeOperands() didn't exist in SQLite 3.41. It was added in the middle of 2025 (commits e24f20a, 280559b). Furthermore, the mechanics of sqlite3ReleaseTempReg() do not involve heap deallocation. The function simply recycles register indices into an array for reuse, making a UAF impossible by design.

/* expr.c:6562, SQLite 3.41.0 */
void sqlite3ReleaseTempReg(Parse *pParse, int iReg){
  if( iReg ){
    sqlite3VdbeReleaseRegisters(pParse, iReg, 1, 0, 0);
    if( pParse->nTempReg < ArraySize(pParse->aTempReg) ){
      pParse->aTempReg[pParse->nTempReg++] = iReg;
    }
  }
}

PoC Testing: The query ran successfully without triggering a crash because the bug does not exist.

Reported Vulnerability: Claims that ExprListDelete() fails to clear back-references in parent structures when releasing child nodes, allegedly patched in version 3.51.3.

Finding: There is no evidence of back-reference pointers in the Expr, Select, or Window structures that could lead to such a state. Most tellingly, a diff between 3.51.2 and 3.51.3 shows absolutely no changes to src/expr.c. The "patch" was entirely fabricated.

PoC Testing: The PoC is invalid SQL and fails at the parser stage, never actually hitting the execution logic.

Reported Vulnerability: Claims a UAF occurs in sqlite3ExprDelete() because a left-hand expression pointer is not cleared, referencing specific line numbers in expr.c.

Finding: The cited line numbers (1012 and 1026) are a comment and a memory allocation call respectively, neither has anything to do with pLeft or deletion logic. While the function is called during OOM error handling, it occurs at the end of a scope where the pointer is never reused, preventing any potential UAF.

/* expr.c:1330, SQLite 3.41.0 */
void sqlite3ExprDelete(sqlite3 *db, Expr *p){
  if( p ) sqlite3ExprDeleteNN(db, p);
}

PoC Testing: Executed successfully as a valid SQL query, returning expected output with zero memory leaks or errors.

Reported Vulnerability: Claims jsonParseFree() leaves dangling references that are later accessed by jsonBlobEdit().

Finding: Similar to the first case, jsonBlobEdit() was not present in the reported target version (3.41.0). It was only introduced later as part of the JSONB implementation. In the target version, jsonParseFree() is used strictly in destructors where the surrounding structure is immediately discarded.

PoC Testing: The PoC hits a malformed JSON error immediately, meaning the code never reaches the JSON modification logic where the vulnerability supposedly exists.

Reported Vulnerability: Reports a UAF in jsonRemoveFunc specifically at lines 3555 and 3575 of json.c.

Finding: In version 3.41.0, src/json.c is only 2706 lines long. The cited line numbers don't exist. The actual implementation of the function was found roughly 2000 lines earlier, and an audit of that code showed no memory management flaws.

PoC Testing: The payload fails during JSON parsing, leaving the memory untouched.

Reported Vulnerability: Claims sqlite3ExprListDelete(pOrderBy) frees the ordering list while subsequent code reads pOrderBy->nExpr.

Finding: The single-argument signature reported in the advisory does not exist. the actual signature requires a pointer to the database context (sqlite3 *db). Furthermore, SQLite explicitly nulls pointers immediately after deletion:

/* select.c:3761, SQLite 3.41.0 */
sqlite3ExprListDelete(db, pPrior->pOrderBy);
pPrior->pOrderBy = 0;   /* Pointer immediately cleared; impossible to dereference */

PoC Testing: The PoC payload executed against a 20-column ORDER BY query processed normally, returning sorted results with no issues.

The CVE submission process via MITRE's public form lacks any real identity verification, meaning virtually anyone can submit a vulnerability description and propose a CVSS score.

Historically, NIST acted as a reliable safety net for this system, experts at the National Vulnerability Database (NVD) manually analyzed, validated, and enriched incoming CVEs before giving them a stamp of approval. But that safety net broke in February 2024.

Hit by a massive surge in vulnerability reports, NIST effectively hit pause on deep analysis. CISA and other Authorized Data Publishers (ADPs) tried to step in with their own enrichment efforts, but the global pipeline is now fragmented and drowning in a massive backlog. Because no step in today's system actually requires a proof-of-concept or bug reproduction, a plausible-sounding fake advisory can slide right through the pipeline and end up in GHSA, downstream databases, and enterprise scanners.

This incident demonstrates a systemic issue with automated vulnerability ingestion. A broader audit of 55 advisories published by the same GitHub account revealed that 54 were completely fabricated, while one contained a real bug wrapped in unverified CVE metadata.

Red Flags to Spot Slop CVEs:

  • Missing Vendor Corroboration: No mention of the issue on official maintainer security pages (e.g., sqlite.org/cves.html).
  • Absent Commit History: No commit hash or pull request linked in reference fields.
  • Metadata Contradictions: Empty CPE product definitions or version ranges that conflict with the advisory narrative.
  • Non-existent Code References: Citing functions that do not exist in the claimed target version or line numbers past EOF.

These LLM slop CVEs can cause organizations to waste time investigating and patching vulnerabilities that do not actually exist, as well as polluting vulnerability databases. In environments where Critical vulnerabilities are automatically prioritized or tickets are opened based on vulnerability scores, such fabricated CVEs can turn into a real burden.

In environments where AI is used to automate vulnerability triage and remediation this becomes even more concerning. An AI agent that encounters a fabricated CVE may attempt to locate the vulnerable function, generate a patch, or recommend changes based on code that does not even exist. Instead of helping security teams remediate real vulnerabilities, it can lead them down a completely wrong path, potentially introducing unnecessary changes and wasting time.

To avoid being affected by this kind of vulnerability noise:

  • Don't blindly trust newly published CVEs by unknown/unvalidated sources.
  • Investigate such critical CVEs to understand whether the score matches the vulnerability.
  • Check if your environment is truly affected by the CVE.
  • Reproduce the reported issue with the provided PoC whenever possible in a safe environment.

We have also formally reported these findings to GHSA, Redhat and NVD to assist in the remediation of these records.

sentences.en: Reported Vulnerability: The advisory claims a heap use-after-free occurs when sqlite3ReleaseTempReg() leaves a dangling pointer in regFree1, which is later dereferenced by exprComputeOperands().
sentences.zh: 报告的漏洞：该通报声称，当 sqlite3ReleaseTempReg() 在 regFree1 中留下悬空指针（稍后由 exprComputeOperands() 取消引用）时，会发生堆释放后使用。

blocks.html_en: Finding: The primary issue here is that exprComputeOperands() didn't exist in SQLite 3.41. It was added in the middle of 2025 (commits e24f20a, 280559b). Furthermore, the mechanics of sqlite3ReleaseTempReg() do not involve heap deallocation. The function simply recycles register indices into an array for reuse, making a UAF impossible by design.

sentences.en: Finding: The primary issue here is that exprComputeOperands() didn't exist in SQLite 3.41.
sentences.zh: 发现：这里的主要问题是 SQLite 3.41 中不存在 exprComputeOperands()。

sentences.en: It was added in the middle of 2025 (commits e24f20a, 280559b).
sentences.zh: 它是在 2025 年中期添加的（提交 e24f20a、280559b）。

sentences.en: Furthermore, the mechanics of sqlite3ReleaseTempReg() do not involve heap deallocation.
sentences.zh: 此外，sqlite3ReleaseTempReg() 的机制不涉及堆释放。

sentences.en: The function simply recycles register indices into an array for reuse, making a UAF impossible by design.
sentences.zh: 该函数只是将寄存器索引回收到数组中以供重用，这使得 UAF 在设计上不可能实现。

blocks.html_en: PoC Testing: The query ran successfully without triggering a crash because the bug does not exist.

sentences.en: PoC Testing: The query ran successfully without triggering a crash because the bug does not exist.
sentences.zh: PoC 测试：查询成功运行，没有触发崩溃，因为 bug 不存在。

blocks.html_en: Reported Vulnerability: Claims that ExprListDelete() fails to clear back-references in parent structures when releasing child nodes, allegedly patched in version 3.51.3.

sentences.en: Reported Vulnerability: Claims that ExprListDelete() fails to clear back-references in parent structures when releasing child nodes, allegedly patched in version 3.51.3.
sentences.zh: 报告的漏洞：声称 ExprListDelete() 在释放子节点时无法清除父结构中的反向引用，据称已在版本 3.51.3 中进行了修补。

blocks.html_en: Finding: There is no evidence of back-reference pointers in the Expr, Select, or Window structures that could lead to such a state. Most tellingly, a diff between 3.51.2 and 3.51.3 shows absolutely no changes to src/expr.c. The "patch" was entirely fabricated.

sentences.en: Finding: There is no evidence of back-reference pointers in the Expr, Select, or Window structures that could lead to such a state.
sentences.zh: 发现：没有证据表明 Expr、Select 或 Window 结构中的反向引用指针可能导致这种状态。

sentences.en: Most tellingly, a diff between 3.51.2 and 3.51.3 shows absolutely no changes to src/expr.c.
sentences.zh: 最明显的是，3.51.2 和 3.51.3 之间的差异表明 src/expr.c 绝对没有变化。

sentences.en: The "patch" was entirely fabricated.
sentences.zh: 这个“补丁”完全是捏造的。

blocks.html_en: PoC Testing: The PoC is invalid SQL and fails at the parser stage, never actually hitting the execution logic.

sentences.en: PoC Testing: The PoC is invalid SQL and fails at the parser stage, never actually hitting the execution logic.
sentences.zh: PoC 测试：PoC 是无效的 SQL，并且在解析器阶段失败，从未真正触及执行逻辑。

blocks.html_en: Reported Vulnerability: Claims a UAF occurs in sqlite3ExprDelete() because a left-hand expression pointer is not cleared, referencing specific line numbers in expr.c.

sentences.en: Reported Vulnerability: Claims a UAF occurs in sqlite3ExprDelete() because a left-hand expression pointer is not cleared, referencing specific line numbers in expr.c.
sentences.zh: 报告的漏洞：声称 sqlite3ExprDelete() 中出现 UAF，因为左侧表达式指针未清除，引用了 expr.c 中的特定行号。

blocks.html_en: Finding: The cited line numbers (1012 and 1026) are a comment and a memory allocation call respectively, neither has anything to do with pLeft or deletion logic. While the function is called during OOM error handling, it occurs at the end of a scope where the pointer is never reused, preventing any potential UAF.

sentences.en: Finding: The cited line numbers (1012 and 1026) are a comment and a memory allocation call respectively, neither has anything to do with pLeft or deletion logic.
sentences.zh: 发现：引用的行号（1012和1026）分别是注释和内存分配调用，与pLeft或删除逻辑没有任何关系。

sentences.en: While the function is called during OOM error handling, it occurs at the end of a scope where the pointer is never reused, preventing any potential UAF.
sentences.zh: 虽然该函数在 OOM 错误处理期间被调用，但它发生在永远不会重用指针的作用域末尾，从而防止任何潜在的 UAF。

blocks.html_en: PoC Testing: Executed successfully as a valid SQL query, returning expected output with zero memory leaks or errors.

sentences.en: PoC Testing: Executed successfully as a valid SQL query, returning expected output with zero memory leaks or errors.
sentences.zh: PoC 测试：作为有效的 SQL 查询成功执行，返回预期输出，内存泄漏或错误为零。

In the target version, jsonParseFree() is used strictly in destructors where the surrounding structure is immediately discarded.

blocks.html_en: The CVE submission process via MITRE's public form lacks any real identity verification, meaning virtually anyone can submit a vulnerability description and propose a CVSS score.

blocks.html_en: Historically, NIST acted as a reliable safety net for this system, experts at the National Vulnerability Database (NVD) manually analyzed, validated, and enriched incoming CVEs before giving them a stamp of approval. But that safety net broke in February 2024.

sentences.en: Historically, NIST acted as a reliable safety net for this system, experts at the National Vulnerability Database (NVD) manually analyzed, validated, and enriched incoming CVEs before giving them a stamp of approval.
sentences.zh: 从历史上看，NIST 充当了该系统的可靠安全网，国家漏洞数据库 (NVD) 的专家在给予批准之前对传入的 CVE 进行手动分析、验证和丰富。

sentences.en: But that safety net broke in February 2024.

blocks.html_en: Hit by a massive surge in vulnerability reports, NIST effectively hit pause on deep analysis. CISA and other Authorized Data Publishers (ADPs) tried to step in with their own enrichment efforts, but the global pipeline is now fragmented and drowning in a massive backlog. Because no step in today's system actually requires a proof-of-concept or bug reproduction, a plausible-sounding fake advisory can slide right through the pipeline and end up in GHSA, downstream databases, and enterprise scanners.

sentences.en: Hit by a massive surge in vulnerability reports, NIST effectively hit pause on deep analysis.

blocks.html_en: This incident demonstrates a systemic issue with automated vulnerability ingestion. A broader audit of 55 advisories published by the same GitHub account revealed that 54 were completely fabricated, while one contained a real bug wrapped in unverified CVE metadata.

blocks.html_en: These LLM slop CVEs can cause organizations to waste time investigating and patching vulnerabilities that do not actually exist, as well as polluting vulnerability databases. In environments where Critical vulnerabilities are automatically prioritized or tickets are opened based on vulnerability scores, such fabricated CVEs can turn into a real burden.

blocks.html_en: In environments where AI is used to automate vulnerability triage and remediation this becomes even more concerning. An AI agent that encounters a fabricated CVE may attempt to locate the vulnerable function, generate a patch, or recommend changes based on code that does not even exist. Instead of helping security teams remediate real vulnerabilities, it can lead them down a completely wrong path, potentially introducing unnecessary changes and wasting time.

content_html_zh:
在过去的几天里，一个新创建的 GitHub 存储库 (programmervuln/cveadvisory-) 发布了一批 SQLite 漏洞报告（作为其他 50 多个 CVE 的一部分，我们认为除了一个之外，这些 CVE 也是 LLM slop）。 NVD 很快将这些标记为关键，CISA 的 ADP 也同意了。 但当 JFrog 安全研究人员深入核实后，这些说法就站不住脚了：

  1. 引用的代码在这些版本中甚至不存在，或者引用了不相关的逻辑。
  2. 在测试 PoC 有效负载时，它们不起作用（未触发任何崩溃）。
  3. 这些 CVE 都没有列在 SQLite 的官方咨询页面上（这是跟踪实际漏洞的黄金标准）。
  4. 此存储库中的所有建议似乎都是在使用 Gptzero 进行测试时由 AI 生成的

将所有建议合并到一个文件中会触发人工智能生成的内容警告

这让我们对这些 CVE 的可靠性产生了疑问，并理解这些 CVE 可能是 LLM 的错误。

昨天在调查其中一个 CVE（CVE-2026-51302）时，我们看到红帽最初为其分配了 10.0 严重严重性评分：

今天再次查看 CVE，我们注意到分数已降至 7.6 高。

CVE 报告的缺陷 CVSS NVD 元数据 审计结果
CVE-2026-51302 exprComputeOperands() 中的 UAF 9.8 关键 固定 CPE：3.41.0 该通报提到了不存在的功能。
CVE-2026-51303 ExprListDelete() 反向引用中的 UAF 9.8 关键 矛盾的元数据 该通报称，不存在修复措施。
CVE-2026-51300 sqlite3ExprDelete() 中的 UAF 9.1 关键 不适用 占位符 公告引用了与该漏洞无关的内容。
CVE-2026-51297 通过 jsonBlobEdit() 的 UAF 8.8 HIGH 固定 CPE：3.41.0 该通报提到了不存在的功能。
CVE-2026-51296 jsonRemoveFunc 中的 UAF 7.5 HIGH 人口 CPE：3.41.0 咨询引用了不存在的线路。
CVE-2026-51304 UAF 通过 pOrderBy->nExpr 无后处理 7.5 HIGH 供应商/产品：不适用 报告显示实数函数的参数编号错误。

为了彻底验证这些报告，我们建立了一个独立的测试工作流程：

  • 源检查：我们克隆了官方 sqlite/sqlite 存储库并检查了目标标签（version-3.41.0、version-3.51.2 和 version-3.51.3）。 我们将报告的漏洞机制与实际源代码进行了比较。
  • 清洁环境构建：直接在隔离的 Docker 容器内编译官方 SQLite 版本，以防止环境污染。
  • PoC 执行：将每个咨询的 PoC SQL 语句逐字输入到 AddressSanitizer (ASan) 工具下编译的 SQLite 二进制文件中，以检测内存错误。
  • NVD 和元数据审计：评估 NVD 和 GHSA 源中的 CPE 模式和咨询元数据，以交叉检查跟踪准确性。

报告的漏洞：该通报声称，当 sqlite3ReleaseTempReg() 在 regFree1 中留下悬空指针（稍后由 exprComputeOperands() 取消引用）时，会发生堆释放后使用。

发现：这里的主要问题是 SQLite 3.41 中不存在 exprComputeOperands()。 它是在 2025 年中期添加的（提交 e24f20a、280559b）。 此外，sqlite3ReleaseTempReg() 的机制不涉及堆释放。 该函数只是将寄存器索引回收到数组中以供重用，这使得 UAF 在设计上不可能实现。

/* expr.c:6562, SQLite 3.41.0 */
void sqlite3ReleaseTempReg(Parse *pParse, int iReg){
  if( iReg ){
    sqlite3VdbeReleaseRegisters(pParse, iReg, 1, 0, 0);
    if( pParse->nTempReg < ArraySize(pParse->aTempReg) ){
      pParse->aTempReg[pParse->nTempReg++] = iReg;
    }
  }
}

PoC 测试：查询成功运行，没有触发崩溃，因为 bug 不存在。

报告的漏洞：声称 ExprListDelete() 在释放子节点时无法清除父结构中的反向引用，据称已在版本 3.51.3 中进行了修补。

发现：没有证据表明 Expr、Select 或 Window 结构中的反向引用指针可能导致这种状态。 最明显的是，3.51.2 和 3.51.3 之间的差异表明 src/expr.c 绝对没有变化。 这个“补丁”完全是捏造的。

PoC 测试：PoC 是无效的 SQL，并且在解析器阶段失败，从未真正触及执行逻辑。

报告的漏洞：声称 sqlite3ExprDelete() 中出现 UAF，因为左侧表达式指针未清除，引用了 expr.c 中的特定行号。

发现：引用的行号（1012和1026）分别是注释和内存分配调用，与pLeft或删除逻辑没有任何关系。 虽然该函数在 OOM 错误处理期间被调用，但它发生在永远不会重用指针的作用域末尾，从而防止任何潜在的 UAF。

/* expr.c:1330, SQLite 3.41.0 */
void sqlite3ExprDelete(sqlite3 *db, Expr *p){
  if( p ) sqlite3ExprDeleteNN(db, p);
}

PoC 测试：作为有效的 SQL 查询成功执行，返回预期输出，内存泄漏或错误为零。

报告的漏洞：声明 jsonParseFree() 留下悬空引用，稍后由 jsonBlobEdit() 访问。

发现：与第一种情况类似，报告的目标版本（3.41.0）中不存在 jsonBlobEdit()。 它后来才作为 JSONB 实现的一部分引入。 在目标版本中， jsonParseFree() 严格在析构函数中使用，周围的结构会立即被丢弃。

PoC 测试：PoC 立即遇到格式错误的 JSON 错误，这意味着代码永远不会到达据称存在漏洞的 JSON 修改逻辑。

报告的漏洞：报告 jsonRemoveFunc 中的 UAF，特别是在 json.c 的第 3555 行和第 3575 行。

发现：在3.41.0版本中，src/json.c只有2706行长。 引用的行号不存在。 该函数的实际实现是在大约 2000 行之前发现的，对该代码的审计表明没有内存管理缺陷。

PoC 测试：有效负载在 JSON 解析期间失败，但内存未受影响。

报告的漏洞：声称 sqlite3ExprListDelete(pOrderBy) 释放排序列表，而后续代码读取 pOrderBy->nExpr。

发现：通报中报告的单参数签名不存在。 实际签名需要一个指向数据库上下文的指针（sqlite3 *db）。 此外，SQLite 在删除后立即显式地将指针清空：

/* select.c:3761, SQLite 3.41.0 */
sqlite3ExprListDelete(db, pPrior->pOrderBy);
pPrior->pOrderBy = 0;   /* Pointer immediately cleared; impossible to dereference */

PoC 测试：针对 20 列 ORDER BY 查询执行的 PoC 负载正常处理，返回排序结果，没有任何问题。

通过 MITRE 公开表格提交 CVE 的过程缺乏任何真实的身份验证，这意味着几乎任何人都可以提交漏洞描述并提出 CVSS 评分。

从历史上看，NIST 充当了该系统的可靠安全网，国家漏洞数据库 (NVD) 的专家在给予批准之前对传入的 CVE 进行手动分析、验证和丰富。 但这个安全网在 2024 年 2 月破裂了。

受到漏洞报告激增的打击，NIST 实际上暂停了深度分析。 CISA 和其他授权数据出版商 (ADP) 试图介入并开展自己的丰富工作，但全球管道现在支离破碎，并淹没在大量积压中。 由于当今系统中的任何步骤实际上都不需要概念验证或错误再现，因此听起来合理的虚假建议可以直接通过管道并最终进入 GHSA、下游数据库和企业扫描仪。

此事件表明自动漏洞摄取存在系统性问题。 对同一 GitHub 帐户发布的 55 条建议进行更广泛的审计后发现，其中 54 条完全是捏造的，而其中一条包含包含在未经验证的 CVE 元数据中的真实错误。

发现斜坡 CVE 的危险信号：

  • 缺少供应商证实：官方维护者安全页面（例如 sqlite.org/cves.html）上没有提及该问题。
  • 缺少提交历史记录：参考字段中没有链接提交哈希或拉取请求。
  • 元数据矛盾：与咨询叙述相冲突的空 CPE 产品定义或版本范围。
  • 不存在的代码引用：引用在声明的目标版本中不存在的函数或 EOF 之后的行号。

这些 LLM slop CVE 可能会导致组织浪费时间调查和修补实际不存在的漏洞，并污染漏洞数据库。 在自动对关键漏洞进行优先级排序或根据漏洞评分开具票证的环境中，此类捏造的 CVE 可能会变成真正的负担。

在使用人工智能自动进行漏洞分类和修复的环境中，这变得更加令人担忧。 遇到伪造的 CVE 的 AI 代理可能会尝试定位易受攻击的函数、生成补丁或根据甚至不存在的代码建议更改。 它不但不能帮助安全团队修复真正的漏洞，反而可能导致他们走上完全错误的道路，可能会引入不必要的更改并浪费时间。

为了避免受到此类漏洞噪音的影响：

  • 不要盲目信任未知/未经验证的来源新发布的 CVE。
  • 调查此类关键 CVE 以了解分数是否与漏洞匹配。
  • 检查您的环境是否真正受到 CVE 的影响。
  • 尽可能在安全的环境中使用提供的 PoC 重现报告的问题。

我们还向 GHSA、Redhat 和 NVD 正式报告了这些发现，以协助修复这些记录。
